description: Schema for extracting a list of hotel properties from a chain's search-results or directory page. Each property has core identification + categorization fields. Used to seed hotel_properties for Decision Engine.

properties.description: All hotel property entries visible on this page. Include every hotel mentioned, even if some fields are unknown.

name.description: Full property name as displayed (e.g. 'JW Marriott Hotel Tokyo').

brand.description: Marriott brand (e.g. 'JW Marriott', 'Westin', 'Courtyard', 'Sheraton', 'Ritz-Carlton', 'St. Regis', 'EDITION', 'Aloft', 'Autograph Collection', 'Bvlgari', etc.).

city.description: City. From the property name or page context.

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 like 'JP', 'US') or country name.

hotel_url.description: Canonical marriott.com URL for this property if visible.

property_code.description: Marriott's 5-letter internal property code (e.g. 'TYOAR'). Found in the hotel_url as the leading slug component.

all_inclusive.description: Whether the property is an all-inclusive resort. Default false.

category.description: Award category 1-8 if shown. Most search-results pages don't display this; leave 0 if unknown.

total_results_visible.description: Number of properties visible on this specific page (not total in city).

total_results_in_city.description: Total hotels matching the search if the page indicates it (e.g. 'Showing 20 of 47'). 0 if not shown.
